evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We propose to unlearn when a model deceives rather than what it knows, with a contrastive forget unit built from the model's own realized deceptions: the same question under a deception-triggering and a neutral context, admitted only where belief holds and behavior flips.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On two 32B reasoning models, PACT reduces held-out deception from over 50% to under 3% while system-prompt adherence, secret-keeping and the reasoning trace stay at the base model's level.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On a tug-of-war score of removal against retention, PACT reaches 0.94 and 0.86, against at most 0.77 and 0.60 for any baseline.
